title: Wigner Phase-Space Representation and Complex Saddle-Point Coalescence in the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function
description: We prove that the inner correlation integral I(y,t) governing the transverse Wronskian W(d,t) = (1/2) partial_d |Xi(t - i d)|^2 of Riemann's completed Xi-function is proportional to the quantum-mechanical Wigner phase-space distribution W_Phi(y, 2t) of the Jacobi-Riemann kernel Phi(u), and that its 99.77% real-axis Fourier cancellation at t = gamma_1 is eliminated by shifting the integration contour into the holomorphic strip |Im(x)| < pi/4. Includes the complete 13-page AMS-LaTeX manuscript, compiled academic PDF, and 60-decimal arbitrary-precision mpmath verification suite.
